title: Wso2am: When using IPAuthenticationProvider in ZooKeeper Admin Server there is a possibility of… (CVE-2024-51504)
description: A critical security vulnerability exists in the wso2am package affecting versions prior to 4.4.0-r1 and 4.5.0-r4. The issue arises when using IPAuthenticationProvider in the ZooKeeper Admin Server, allowing an attacker to bypass authentication by spoofing IP addresses. This vulnerability impacts only IP-based authentication mechanisms implemented in the ZooKeeper Admin Server. A fix is available in versions 4.4.0-r1 and 4.5.0-r4.
